locator: I q.46 a.2 ad 7: sicut si lapis moveretur a baculo, et baculus a manu, et hoc in infinitum
interpretation: The example of per se efficient causes is the prima via's own series of moved movers (stone, stick, hand). Read generally: a mover that moves only as moved (MovesAsMoved, the prima via's per se link) is, in that, an efficient cause causing only as caused. This generalizes from the shared paradigm; it does not identify moving with efficient causing in general, only the per se link of the one series with that of the other.
